description: A Java class 'MediaCodecBridge' that wraps Android's MediaCodec API for media processing, including configuration, buffer management, error handling, and frame rate estimation.

classes.name: MediaCodecBridge
classes.description: A wrapper class for Android's MediaCodec API, managing media encoding/decoding, configuration, buffer handling, error reporting, and frame rate estimation.

classes.name: MediaCodecBridge.DequeueInputResult
classes.description: Represents the result of dequeuing an input buffer from MediaCodec.

classes.name: MediaCodecBridge.DequeueOutputResult
classes.description: Represents the result of dequeuing an output buffer from MediaCodec.

classes.name: MediaCodecBridge.GetOutputFormatResult
classes.description: Wraps the output format information from MediaCodec, including crop and resolution details.

classes.name: MediaCodecBridge.ColorInfo
classes.description: Holds color and HDR static info for configuring video formats.

classes.name: MediaCodecBridge.CreateMediaCodecBridgeResult
classes.description: Holds the result of creating a MediaCodecBridge, including success or error message.

methods.name: createVideoMediaCodecBridge
methods.description: Creates and configures a MediaCodec for video decoding with specified parameters, including HDR and tunnel mode support.

methods.name: configureVideo
methods.description: Configures the MediaCodec with a given MediaFormat, Surface, MediaCrypto, and other parameters.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate and updates the operating rate accordingly.

methods.name: updateOperatingRate
methods.description: Updates the MediaCodec's operating rate based on playback speed and frame rate.

methods.name: configureAudio
methods.description: Configures the MediaCodec for audio playback.

methods.name: maybeSetMaxVideoInputSize
methods.description: Estimates and sets the maximum input buffer size for video formats.
